blocks.text: East Newton homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

East Newton, September 2026. Detached houses: 120 listed at month end and 7 sold in September, a sales ratio of 6% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 132 listed at month end and 11 sold in September, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 39 sold over 4 months against an average of 123.5 listed, about 12.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 13 sold. Condos and townhomes: 39 sold over 4 months against an average of 132.5 listed, about 13.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 13 sold.

faq.a: In Surrey's Newton community — the City describes East Newton as the neighbourhoods around Chimney Hill, east of 144 Street, north of 64 Avenue and Hyland Creek, and south of Bear Creek, planned through the East Newton North, East Newton South and East Newton Business Park NCPs.

faq.q: What plans govern East Newton now?
faq.a: The 1990s NCPs planned the subdivisions and the area is now largely built out, but the City states East Newton North was rescinded and East Newton South's and the Business Park's designations were superseded by the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan update — read the current OCP and Zoning Bylaw, not just the old NCP documents.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in East Newton?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in East Newton is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
